assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game animation sprite atlas for a 2D side-scrolling platformer. Use the attached image as a CHARACTER IDENTITY reference, not as a layout. Create new animation poses of exactly that same character. Polished stylized 3D rendered game sprites, crisp silhouette, restrained small-scale detail, identical materials, proportions, camera angle and soft neutral studio lighting in every cell. All poses face toward screen RIGHT, three-quarter side view appropriate to horizontal movement. Orthographic camera, no perspective changes. No text, numbers, captions, grid lines, borders, scenery, ground, cast shadows or checkerboard pattern. Actual transparent alpha around every sprite. Every cell contains one full-body character, safely separated from every other cell by transparent margins; keep every head, hand, foot and effect wholly inside its own cell. Keep the character the same size throughout the atlas; keep a common ground baseline and the same central torso position. Change body poses convincingly, not just translation or duplicate images. Use real alternating arm and leg motion. HERO ATLAS: exactly FOUR equal-width columns and SEVEN equal-height rows (28 cells), a tall 4:7 sheet, preferably 1024 by 1792 pixels. Match this friendly compact purple armored robot hero, bright cyan face visor with two cyan eyes, purple helmet side fins, white/silver armor trim, cyan chest/arm lights, large purple boots. Preserve this identity, no new costume or weapon. Row 1: four subtly different breathing idle poses. Row 2: running cycle frames 1,2,3,4: left foot contact, left downstroke, passing, left push-off. Row 3: running cycle frames 5,6,7,8: right foot contact, right downstroke, passing, right push-off, completing a seamless loop. Row 4: jump launch pose, rising jump with knees drawn up, falling with legs reaching down, second falling anticipation pose. Row 5: four shooting poses: arm raises toward screen right, wrist aims, wrist releases a small cyan pulse, arm recoils. Row 6: two landing compression/recovery poses followed by two brief hurt recoil poses. Row 7: four non-gory defeat poses: stagger, knees buckle, fall to side, lying inert on the ground. Defeat poses occupy less height naturally; do not enlarge the lying robot to fill the cell.
assets.refinement_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit and background-extraction. This is a game sprite atlas. Keep the exact existing character identity, all existing poses, row order, column order, common character size and the 4-column grid. Do not redesign or rearrange it. Remove all fired projectiles, beams, trails, large energy balls, large muzzle flashes, floating particles and stray glow flecks between cells; the real game renders projectiles separately. Keep only restrained lights that are physically attached to the character's visor, armor, wrist and chest. Give every sprite completely clean transparent alpha around it: remove all purple background gradients, checkerboards, floor surfaces, cast shadows and any colored rectangular backing. Keep the dark robot armor intact. Every frame must be fully isolated inside its own evenly spaced cell with at least 10 pixels of clear transparent separation at each cell boundary, no parts intruding into a neighboring cell. Preserve all original frame counts, poses and compact full-body scale. No labels, text, frames or visible grid. Output actual RGBA transparency, not a picture of a transparency checkerboard.
